deterministic_family_selection_rule.selection_outcome: NONE unless exactly one family remains after all rules; rule runs before model outputs.
tie_break_order: fixed_lexicographic_family_order: connected_components, inside_contains, width, difference, orientation

INCONCLUSIVE: valid boundary but fewer than 48 canonical units

before_generation: legitimate TRAIN asset path/repository revision and SHA256
identity_and_determinism_contract.generation_determinism: same source, inputs and seed must produce byte-identical manifests; failure is INVALID_NOT_INTERPRETABLE.

later_prefreeze_quantitative_contract.insufficient_units: INCONCLUSIVE; never relax count or split.
later_prefreeze_quantitative_contract.primary_estimand: validation exact-grid rate conditioned on matched-control success at canonical latent-task unit
later_prefreeze_quantitative_contract.stratification: bind family-relevant structural strata or state NONE prospectively

requirements.family_selection_rule: Before any new model outputs: select only a family with valid unsaturated frozen baseline exact-grid evidence, exact verified TRAIN content and latent provenance, an available deterministic generator, and matched control capacity. Nominal scalar-loss share alone cannot select a family.
requirements.independent_units: Resample/gate at canonical latent-task unit; do not count prompt variants as independent units.
requirements.latent_parameter_manifest: Each TRAIN and validation unit stores canonical latent parameter SHA256 and family-relevant structural signature.
requirements.legitimate_train_content_manifest: Every TRAIN episode stores canonical public input/output content SHA256, generator revision, source provenance, and family label before model outputs.
requirements.matched_controls: Each atomic family requires a functionally sufficient control and a single target operation with identical layout/color marginal distributions where feasible.
overlap_gates: no validation target used in training construction or selection
requirements.validation_split: Validation must be content-SHA-disjoint and latent-signature-disjoint from TRAIN; roles are frozen before inference.

structural_holdout_contract.binding_requirement: Later proposal chooses exactly one axis from its selected family and records TRAIN and validation allowed/excluded values before generation.
structural_holdout_contract.canonical_latent_signature_schema: family_name + operation_parameters + object_count + topology + relation/orientation + grid_layout + color_role_mapping; exact fields must be bound per selected family before cohort generation.
structural_holdout_contract.scientific_holdout_definition: A prospectively named family-relevant structural factor or factor-combination is absent from TRAIN and reserved for validation. Content/latent hash inequality verifies integrity only and never defines the holdout.
